I have checked the co-founder's inbox and reviewed the contract success criteria. The backlog has many cards, including several bugs blocking ghost AI development.

I created a new bug card #0093 to implement the missing src.backend.ghost_ai module, which is blocking backend tests and ghost-related cards. This serves the criterion about four ghosts with distinct behaviors.

I moved the overdue card #0066 (Finalize ghost AI behaviors and visuals) to todo and assigned it to the senior dev, noting the dependency on fixing the missing module first.

I also moved the overdue card #0072 (Complete UI state overlays for Game Over and Level Up) to todo and assigned it to the UI dev, with a note to prepare once backend issues are resolved.

Next, I suggest we proceed with the bug fix for the missing ghost_ai module to unblock ghost AI development.
